value.rationale: The count of interventions and accumulated local exposure are physically distinct jointly useful observables. The exact conditional Poisson law reconstructs every reset-count probability from measured exposure, with Gamma reverse conditionals and model-independent correlation sqrt(1-q), for Brownian/OU and regular diffusions. This goes beyond a marginal calculation and is useful for interpreting hidden interventions. Finite spatial-bin observations are not exactly the mathematical local time.
